CREATE TABLE departments (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, building TEXT, lanyard_colour TEXT);
CREATE TABLE people (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, role TEXT, department TEXT, phone TEXT);
CREATE TABLE incidents (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, incident_date TEXT, location TEXT, description TEXT, status TEXT);
CREATE TABLE statements (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, incident_id INTEGER, person_id INTEGER, statement TEXT);
CREATE TABLE keycard_log (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, person_id INTEGER, door TEXT, swipe_time TEXT, direction TEXT);
CREATE TABLE vehicles (plate TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner_id INTEGER, make TEXT, colour TEXT);
CREATE TABLE car_park_log (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, plate TEXT, entry_time TEXT, exit_time TEXT);
CREATE TABLE bank_transfers (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, sender_id INTEGER, recipient_id INTEGER, amount REAL, transfer_date TEXT, reference TEXT);
CREATE TABLE cctv_log (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, camera TEXT, log_time TEXT, status TEXT, changed_by INTEGER);
